scope: Targeted review of all remaining exact-name National Partnership overlap candidates across the A Faithful PCA June 2021 and March 2022 signer snapshots and the 2019 Warhurst protest signer roster.
method: Each identity is approved only where an existing reviewed identity, matching office/presbytery/institution context, or independent official/first-party historical evidence bridges the National Partnership record to the later source row. Same-name overlap alone is never sufficient.
guardrails: Identity resolution connects separately sourced facts to the same person; it does not infer a generic ideological label or agreement on unrelated issues.
National Partnership membership remains sourced only from explicit membership/addition/Partnership-roster evidence already admitted to the canonical NP source layer.
A Faithful PCA and Warhurst participation remain distinct public actions and do not themselves establish NP membership.
Presbytery changes are retained as dated ministry history rather than rewritten into same-context matches.
David Ridenhour's NP archival presbytery label is preserved as printed even though official 2018-2019 PCA records place him in North Texas.
Tag Tuck's source-level office conflict is preserved: the NP archive prints TE while the 2019 Warhurst/attendance material prints RE; this receipt resolves identity, not the office discrepancy.
No global name-matching rule is relaxed by these person-specific decisions.
